title: colcon build: "listing git files failed - pretending there aren't any" in ament_python packages (measured)
excerpt: The message comes from pip-installed setuptools_scm, not ROS, and the build still succeeds. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: when it appears, the one setuptools_scm case that really fails the build, and the ament_python 'marker' warning.
